title: Classement - 42km du Mont-Blanc 2026 (official ranking PDF)
claims: The 2026 42 km ranking lists Remi Bonnet first in 3:33:14 (SUI), Frederic Tranchand second in 3:35:46 (FRA), Manuel Merillas Moledo third in 3:41:43 (ESP), Adrien Briffod fourth in 3:46:20 (SUI) and Kevin Kibet fifth in 3:46:42 (KEN).

The same ranking lists Antonio Martinez Perez sixth in 3:51:16 (ESP), Loic Robert seventh in 3:53:10 (FRA), Miquel Corbera Rubio eighth in 3:53:35 (ESP) and Sammy Rotich Chelangat ninth in 3:54:00 (KEN).
The ranking PDF is titled 'Marathon du Mont-Blanc Classement - 42km du Mont-Blanc' and is dated 19 October 2026 in the page footer.
